The Vintage Camper Van

A toy brick model · 82 pieces · 13 steps · ages 7+

Happy birthday! This classic split-window camper has a lift-off roof, a bench seat and steering wheel, a bed with pillows, a little stove, a big side door for your minifigures, and a surfboard on the roof rack.

1

Wheels and axles

Stand the 4 black Technic bricks on the table in two pairs, with a 4-stud gap inside each pair. Slide an 8-long axle through each pair, then push a wheel onto each end. Make sure the wheels spin freely!

4×
2×
4×
2

Chassis

Press the big 6x14 plate onto the Technic bricks. Each pair sits on the 3rd and 4th studs from one end. No 6x14 plate? Use a 6x8 plus a 6x6 placed side by side; the walls will lock them together.

1×

Gray bumpers go across the front and back. Turquoise plates run down both sides.

Rounded roof top

The 4x12 plate locks the roof together and gives it a rounded, stepped look. Now the whole roof lifts off in one piece to play inside!

Roof rack & surfboard

Ready for a road trip!

  • Lift the roof off to put minifigures in the bed or behind the wheel.
  • Swap the surfboard for a canoe, bikes, or a pile of luggage.
  • Try a new paint job: red, orange, or sky blue with a white roof all look great.
